# Descriptions
@@ 1
Target takes 25% of his remaining concussion hits (i.e., those not already
taken). These hits are restored when the duration is up, provided target has
not died.
@@ 2
Target is stunned.
@@ 3
Target must subtract 25 from all orientation and Awareness maneuvers, and 5
from all initiative rolls.
@@ 4
Target must subtract 25 from all maneuver rolls.
@@ 5
Target must subtract 25 from all attack rolls.
@@ 6
As Jolts I, except for duration.
@@ 7
As Minor Pain, except 50% of remaining hits are taken.
@@ 8
Target forgets a period of (1 minute per level) of his past, as desired by the
caster.
@@ 9
As Major Pain, except hits must be healed normally.
@@ 10
As Disorientation, Unbalance, and Distortions (all at once).
@@ 11
Target mind blanks out for a period of 10 minutes each day at random. Target
is incapable of activity or thought during this period.
@@ 12
As Jolts I, except for duration.
@@ 13
Target’s mind is completely blank for the duration. He cannot perceive events,
time, or activity. At the end of the duration of this spell, he is stunned for
1 round after his mind comes back.
@@ 14
As Disorientation, except affects a number of targets equal to the caster’s
level.
@@ 15
Target is a blathering idiot. He can be lead around, but he can take no
action.
@@ 16
As Unbalance, except affects a number of targets equal to the caster’s level.
@@ 17
As any single 10th level or lower spell on this list, except with a range of
300'.
@@ 18
As Distortions, except affects a number of targets equal to the caster’s
level.
@@ 19
[RR Mod: -20] The target believes he is being engaged by a creature of the his
own worst fears. The target will be attacked each round by the creature (who
has a +100 Martial Arts Strikes Rank I attack; the damage is real). Regardless
of the damage done by the target (to the creature), the creature will only be
defeated when the target makes his RR (one RR each minute), or when he loses
consciousness.
@@ 20
Target loses 5% of his collected experience (usually experience points). Note
that the target will not lose a level, only experience points (which means he
will have to gain that many more experience points to gain his next level).
@@ 25
As Major Pain, except as many targets as the caster’s level are affected, the
duration is until healed, and the range is 300'.
@@ 30
As Mind Shock, except as many targets as the caster’s level can be affected
and the range is 300'.
@@ 50
As Unminding, except as many targets as the caster’s level can be affected and
the range is 300'.
